document.abstract: This report of the Progress Committee covers the year 1939. The advances in the cinematographic art are classified as follows: (I) Cinematography (A) Professional, (B) Substandard; (II) Sound Recording; (III) Sound and Picture Reploduction; (IV) Television; (V) Publications and New Books.
